title: Fake Aliyun AI Labs SDKs on PyPI hid an infostealer in a PyTorch model
summary: Three PyPI packages published on 19 May 2025 described themselves as a Python SDK for Aliyun AI Labs services but contained no SDK code; their initialisation script loaded a PyTorch model whose pickle payload delivered an infostealer. ReversingLabs reported them and all three were gone from PyPI within a day.
severity_rationale: Credential and environment theft aimed at AI and ML developers, limited by availability of under 24 hours and a small download count.
